whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Herbalife Fitness center Weight loss,

I noticed your fitness center has earned a perfect 5.0★ rating on Bailey Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new weight loss inquiries.

Maine aapke fitness center ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, weight loss program details, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/herbalifefitness

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Herbalife Fitness center team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness center ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha Bailey Road location ke liye. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for weight loss inquiries. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
